verdict.rationale: Jan ships a local OpenAI-compatible inference server powered by llama.cpp, so serving throughput is a fair axis for this product. However, no evidence mentions continuous batching, chunked prefill, parallel request slots, or any throughput tuning. The llama.cpp engine reference alone does not document these capabilities in Jan.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
